contradictions.contradiction: Record headline profitability coexists with a material temporary tariff-refund benefit; this qualifies, rather than falsifies, the strong consolidated execution signal.

Very strong reported gross-margin performance coexists with tariff-related policy volatility and previously disclosed temporary tariff-refund benefits, so recurring margin quality requires Alpha normalization rather than headline extrapolation.

Apple describes diversified component sourcing and adequate liquidity while simultaneously carrying $57.0B of manufacturing purchase obligations, $56.2B due within 12 months; this is resilience capacity plus meaningful execution commitment rather than evidence of either pure flexibility or pure fragility.
